Case of the petitioners is that pursuant to notification, issued under the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, 1990, land measuring 13 marlas, 158.80 Sfts, falling under Survey No. 1294 came to be acquired by respondent No. 4 in the year 2011 and compensation with respect to the said land was paid to land owners in a High Level Committee meeting, held by Divisional Commissioner,
Kashmir on 18.10.2011.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
This was followed by a sale deed in favour of the Government with respect to Survey Nos. 1297,1125,1296,1298,1299, Khewat No. 173,621 situate in village Khanyar, Tehsil,
Srinagar.
However, the said sale deed does not contain Survey No. 1294 which was acquired by the Government.

Allegation of the petitioners is that on 13th April, 2025, officials of Jammu and Kashmir Wakf Board trespassed into their proprietary land compromised under Survey No. 1297, and partially demolished a single storeyed structure.
They preferred a representation before Divisional Commissioner, Kashmir, which was forwarded to Tehsildar, Khanyar, Srinagar for verification of contents made thereto.

Perusal of the file reveals that a team of revenue officials came to be constituted, who submitted a report on 14.05.2025, that Survey No. 1297 is comprised of 14 marlas, out of which land measuring 8 marlas is under the possession of the petitioners.
Grievance of the petitioners is that despite aforesaid report submitted by the team of revenue officials, respondents are interfering in their peaceful possession.

sentences.text: 1 Prima facie case for indulgence is made.
Notice in the main as also in CM returnable within four weeks.
Requisite steps within one week.
List on 3rd February, 2026.
Meanwhile, respondents are directed to maintain status-quo with respect to subject land comprised Survey No. 1297, measuring 8 marlas.

This order shall however, be subject to alteration/modification and objections from the other side (Rajesh Sekhri) Judge SRINAGAR 02.12.2025.
"Abdul Rashid"
